component.name: Polecat Browser
component.summary: A modern, privacy-focused web browser for Debian Linux

description.p: Polecat Browser is a fast, simple, Linux-first web browser built with Qt and Qt WebEngine. It offers normal web browsing, tabbed windows, bookmarks and history, a download manager, private browsing, privacy controls and optional study tools, in a clean GNOME-inspired interface.
It includes no telemetry and no advertisements, and it does not send your browsing data anywhere unless you explicitly enable a feature that requires it.
First release: browsing, tabs, windows, bookmarks, history, downloads, private browsing, GNOME-inspired UI and Debian packaging.
